shared_elements: marking applied to a natural rock surface
justification: Both surfaces bear a single non-figural or barely figural motif on an unshaped rock face, built from rounded lobes and a curving elongated limb-like extension, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a flat painted blob of a few merged rounded masses with no internal detail, while B is a carved composition of nested concentric arcs and multiple curved ridges suggesting a spiral or face-like design, so the specific forms, their number and their relationships differ entirely.
